repairs: Combined incoming capability enums, loader contracts, rule queries, continuations, event observers, host APIs, operation AI semantics and general/artwork/test registration with the cumulative dirty working tree.
Retained both PlayEnding Pindian and phase insertion capabilities; unioned actual-use ordinal and same-suit history tracking dependencies.
Retained operation-owned PaidTargetEnding validation rather than a growing trigger-window exception list.

Frozen eight collection-bearing event classes in CommittedEventProjection: seven introduced by the external batches plus the reachable existing Bijing punish event LostCardIds and DiscardedCardIds. Source mutation and observer write coverage extends the existing shared check.
RoundStarting is accepted by the lifecycle boundary invariant with its typed continuation and normal-round guard.
Fengji round opportunity is offered to every living owner, including a foreign seat; a short native command/cold recovery check covers the regression.

versionSources.reason: Rules epoch changes only because the same RoundStarting/Fengji fingerprint can replay accepted commands differently. Schema and package versions were not changed.
